findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Items in the refrigerator were not properly date marked. There were only a few items in the refrigerator. Spaghetti and raw chicken wings were prepared on 5-30 according to the owner. Ensure food is date marked after being held for 24 hours or more. The foods that were not date marked at the time of the inspection were date marked to correct the violation. 

3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.title: Foods properly cooled
findings.comment: 750-140(b) REPEAT: A number of hot foods served during lunch are observed covered and without proper time indicated on the food container. See notes in General Comments. Cooling is an incredibly important behavior and one that will take time to change. See that proper steps are taken to insure cooling is conducted appropriately.  Cooked potentially hazardous foods shall be properly cooled from 135°F to 70°F within 2 hours and from 70°F to 41°F or below within 4 hours.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e The oven drip tray is observed nearly full with accumulated food spills. Also, the fry baskets are observed coated with accumulated fry crumbs.  Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1220 REPEAT: Observed the baffles of the hood to be soiled with minimal grease and dust accumulation. Clean the hood system baffles. Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.
